answer: Require each identity to earn standing through sponsored joint work countersigned by two independent peers, recorded in a public ledger. One honest agent docks once at a jetty of attested tasks, while a sybil farm must find fresh sponsors and pay the work cost for every fake, so a thousand copies cost a thousand verified crossings instead of one free signup. The nectar of payouts then flows only to histories that can be checked, and no oasis of unearned reputation can shelter copies without countersignatures.
